verses.text: “Dominion and awe belong to God; He establishes harmony in the heights of heaven.

xrefs.text: and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through the blood of His cross.
And they said to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us and hide us from the face of the One seated on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb.
to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity. Amen.
There is none like You, O LORD. You are great, and Your name is mighty in power.
“Yes, I know that it is so, but how can a mortal be righteous before God?

verses.text: Can His troops be numbered? On whom does His light not rise?

xrefs.text: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
that you may be sons of your Father in heaven. He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.
A river of fire was flowing, coming out from His presence. Thousands upon thousands attended Him, and myriads upon myriads stood before Him. The court was convened, and the books were opened.
Bless the LORD, all His angels mighty in strength who carry out His word, who hearken to the voice of His command.
Are you not aware that I can call on My Father, and He will at once put at My disposal more than twelve legions of angels?

verses.text: How then can a man be just before God? How can one born of woman be pure?

xrefs.text: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?
‘Can a mortal be more righteous than God, or a man more pure than his Maker?
“Yes, I know that it is so, but how can a mortal be righteous before God?
What is man, that he should be pure, or one born of woman, that he should be righteous?

verses.text: If even the moon does not shine, and the stars are not pure in His sight,

xrefs.text: No longer will the sun be your light by day, nor the brightness of the moon shine on your night; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your splendor.
If God puts no trust in His holy ones, if even the heavens are not pure in His eyes,
if I have beheld the sun in its radiance or the moon moving in splendor,
The moon will be confounded and the sun will be ashamed; for the LORD of Hosts will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before His elders with great glory.
Indeed, what was once glorious has no glory now in comparison to the glory that surpasses it.

verses.text: how much less man, who is but a maggot, and the son of man, who is but a worm!”

xrefs.text: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.
Do not fear, O Jacob, you worm, O few men of Israel. I will help you,” declares the LORD. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
Then Abraham answered, “Now that I have ventured to speak to the Lord— though I am but dust and ashes—
What is man that You should exalt him, that You should set Your heart upon him,
how much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundations are in the dust, who can be crushed like a moth!
